verdict.rationale: Galileo is a SaaS platform that ingests customer traces and datasets, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any such control or policy. Mentions of distilling evals into Luna models and auto-tuning metrics from feedback describe product features, not a data-use opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
